correctness.rationale: For n>=5 each edge-neighborhood union is the four-block {i-1,i,i+1,i+2}; double counting its selected incidences gives |D|>=ceil(n/2). Cyclic selection every other vertex attains this. For cyclic gaps d_i between selected vertices, the every-four-block constraint is equivalent to d_i+d_{i+1}<=4. With e_i=2-d_i in {-1,0,1}, require e_i+e_{i+1}>=0 and sum e_i=2k-n (zero for even, one for odd). Every minus is flanked by plusses; each nonzero run separated by zeroes has positive total; this forces the stated all-2 or cyclic 1,3 patterns. An odd alternating run with r threes has r+1 ones and remaining 2s, yielding k cyclic anchored words and exactly n labeled sets per r. Exceptions C3,C4 checked directly. Independent exhaustive actual edge-neighborhood enumeration n3..15 verified 223 minimum sets and no smaller feasible sets. There is no reliance on the transfer counts to prove the infinite classification.
